title: Physics-guided surrogate learning enables zero-shot control of turbulent wings
abstract: arXiv:2604.09434v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Turbulent boundary layers over aerodynamic surfaces are a major source of aircraft drag, yet their control remains challenging due to multiscale dynamics and spatial variability, particularly under adverse pressure gradients. Reinforcement learning has outperformed state-of-the-art strategies in canonical flows, but its application to realistic geometries is limited by computational cost and transferability. Here we show that these limitations can be overcome by exploiting local structures of wall-bounded turbulence. Policies are trained in turbulent channel flows matched to wing boundary-layer statistics and deployed directly onto a NACA4412 wing section at $Re_c=2\times10^5$ without additional training on the wing, constituting zero-shot deployment. translated_title: 物理引导的代理学习实现湍流机翼的零样本控制
translated_abstract: 气动表面上的湍流边界层是飞机阻力的主要来源，然而由于多尺度动力学特性和空间变异性，尤其在逆压梯度条件下，其控制仍然极具挑战性。强化学习在典型流动中已超越最先进的控制策略，但其在真实几何形状上的应用受到计算成本和可迁移性的限制。本研究表明，通过利用壁面约束湍流的局部结构，可以克服这些限制。策略在与机翼边界层统计特性相匹配的湍流槽道流中进行训练，随后直接部署到雷诺数 $Re_c=2\times10^5$ 的 NACA4412 翼型上，而无需在机翼上进行任何额外训练，构成零样本部署。迁移后的策略使总阻力降低了 11.1%，而最先进的对向控制仅能降低 8.9%。在考虑执行成本的情况下，相应的……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该研究利用壁面湍流的局部结构，通过物理引导的代理学习，将在槽道流中训练的强化学习策略直接零样本迁移部署到 NACA4412 机翼上，实现 11.1% 的总阻力降低，超越了最先进的对向控制方法（8.9%）。
